mapper.select: SELECT MC.member_coupon_id, MC.member_id, MC.coupon_id, C.coupon_name, C.discount_type, C.discount_value, C.minimum_order_amount, C.maximum_discount_amount, MC.issued_at, C.valid_from, C.valid_until, MC.used_at, MC.coupon_status, OC.order_id, OC.discount_amount, CASE WHEN MC.coupon_status = 'USED' THEN 'USED' WHEN MC.coupon_status = 'EXPIRED' THEN 'EXPIRED' WHEN C.valid_until < NOW() THEN 'EXPIRED' ELSE 'AVAILABLE' END AS display_status FROM MEMBER_COUPON MC INNER JOIN COUPON C ON MC.coupon_id = C.coupon_id LEFT JOIN ORDER_COUPON OC ON MC.member_coupon_id = OC.member_coupon_id WHERE MC.member_id = #{memberId} ORDER BY MC.issued_at DESC
SELECT coupon_id, coupon_name, discount_type, discount_value, minimum_order_amount, maximum_discount_amount, valid_from, valid_until FROM COUPON ORDER BY coupon_id DESC
SELECT coupon_id, coupon_name, discount_type, discount_value, minimum_order_amount, maximum_discount_amount, valid_from, valid_until FROM COUPON WHERE coupon_id = #{couponId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO COUPON ( coupon_name, discount_type, discount_value, minimum_order_amount, maximum_discount_amount, valid_from, valid_until ) VALUES ( #{couponName}, #{discountType}, #{discountValue}, #{minimumOrderAmount}, #{maximumDiscountAmount}, #{validFrom}, #{validUntil} )
mapper.update: UPDATE COUPON SET coupon_name = #{couponName}, discount_type = #{discountType}, discount_value = #{discountValue}, minimum_order_amount = #{minimumOrderAmount}, maximum_discount_amount = #{maximumDiscountAmount}, valid_from = #{validFrom}, valid_until = #{validUntil} WHERE coupon_id = #{couponId}
